name: TypeSafe
description: Ask the Jev model yes/no, multiple-choice and scoring questions and get calibrated answers.

methods.label: Connect with an API key
methods.whenToUse: Use a TypeSafe API key so agents can ask Jev typed questions.

credentialFields.label: TypeSafe API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Content an agent submits for evaluation is sent to TypeSafe. Grant access only to agents whose task content may leave this instance.

extensionFields.label: Issue triage
extensionFields.helperMd: Classify an issue's next action (resume, reassign, unblock, escalate, close).

extensionFields.label: Plan review
extensionFields.helperMd: Check a plan states a clear outcome and how to verify it before execution.

extensionFields.label: Acceptance checks
extensionFields.helperMd: Score acceptance-criteria coverage and per-criterion pass/fail.

extensionFields.label: Priority and severity
extensionFields.helperMd: Score severity and impact to suggest an issue priority.

extensionFields.label: Inbox gardening
extensionFields.helperMd: Decide which inbox items are safe to archive.

extensionFields.label: Outbound guardrails
extensionFields.helperMd: Screen outbound messages for leaked content or policy risk.

methods.guidanceMd: Create an API key in your TypeSafe account and paste it here. Agents you select can then ask Jev questions about text or data from their tasks.
warnings: Content an agent submits for evaluation is sent to TypeSafe. Grant access only to agents whose task content may leave this instance.
